facts.fact: The APDPVP, headed by president Joël Dominique Ledaga, held a data protection awareness day in Port-Gentil on 10 November 2026.

facts.fact: At the awareness day the APDPVP said only about 24 of roughly 300 Port-Gentil firms comply, with no decision or sanction stated.
